verses.text: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
lines: The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh!
How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

verses.text: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips.
lines: You have given him his heart’s desire,
and have not withheld the request of his lips.

verses.text: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.
lines: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness.
You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

verses.text: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.
lines: He asked life of you and you gave it to him,
even length of days forever and ever.

verses.text: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
lines: His glory is great in your salvation.
You lay honor and majesty on him.

verses.text: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.
lines: For you make him most blessed forever.
You make him glad with joy in your presence.

verses.text: For the king trusts in Yahweh. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.
lines: For the king trusts in Yahweh.
Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

verses.text: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.
lines: Your hand will find out all of your enemies.
Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

verses.text: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.
lines: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger.
Yahweh will swallow them up in his wrath.
The fire shall devour them.

verses.text: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.
lines: You will destroy their descendants from the earth,
their posterity from among the children of men.

verses.text: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.
lines: For they intended evil against you.
They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

verses.text: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.
lines: For you will make them turn their back,
when you aim drawn bows at their face.

verses.text: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.
lines: Be exalted, Yahweh, in your strength,
so we will sing and praise your power.
